PROJECT DESCRIPTION
This project includes the installation of a continuous multi-duct conduit system with vaults and locate system
to accommodate a fiber-interconnection. This does not include service drop conduit to homes and businesses.
The boundaries of construction and locations are detailed in the A.02 Property Location.
